info.title: Plenio Song API
info.summary: Make songs with Plenio on a running ComfyUI: every template, review stops, songs, events.
info.description: Make songs with the Plenio Music Production System on a running ComfyUI: choose one of the five templates, give its fields, queue the job - stop it where the Song Sheet stops to read or edit the lyrics and the score -, follow it (?wait or the event stream), download its files; make a released song again. Plenio 2.0.0, ComfyUI 0.41.0. Jobs are kept on disk and survive a restart of ComfyUI. This computer needs no token; another computer sends one (Plenio Setup > API access). The path carries the major version (/v2); a minor version only adds. v1 stays served as it was. Guide: docs/api/README.md.

get.summary: Where every bar of the take's score lies in its audio
get.description: A YuE2 take keeps no steady tempo. These are the times of every measure's start in the score (at its own tempo) and in the take's audio, measured from the music - for a DAW's tempo map, so that the metronome and further tracks keep to the take. 'bars' is null when the score and the music do not meet ('why' says so). Measured once, then kept.

mode.title: mode
mode.description: new song every run: each run writes and renders another song from this brief (the batch count next to Run makes a series). one song, stop to review: the Song Sheets stop for checking; later runs render new takes. Fixed in the API: a job asks for review stops with 'review'.

template.title: template
template.description: Optional starting point. Text fields you leave empty are taken from the template.

description.title: description
description.description: How the song should sound - its character, instruments and arrangement (the lyrics have a field of their own). Sent to the writing model.
description.default: Honest acoustic singer-songwriter song: fingerpicked or gently strummed acoustic guitar, subtle piano, upright bass and brushed drums entering late, plus a close, unpolished vocal with audible breath. Conversational verses, one quietly devastating refrain, minimal production and lots of space.

length.title: length
length.description: Target length. Guides the writing and, without a score, the render ceiling.

vocals.title: vocals
vocals.description: sung: a song with lyrics. sparse vocals: mostly instrumental, the voice sings only a few short phrases (a hook, a call, wordless sounds like 'ooh'). instrumental: no singing; hides all vocal settings.

language.title: language
language.description: Language of the lyrics, e.g. 'English'. Only when vocals is sung, sparse vocals.

voice.title: voice
voice.description: Vocal character, e.g. 'warm female voice'. Only when vocals is sung, sparse vocals.

theme.title: theme
theme.description: What the lyrics are about, in a few words. Only when vocals is sung, sparse vocals.

enum: my own, sung as written below
lyrics_from.title: lyrics
lyrics_from.description: written from the idea below: the writer writes the lyrics; the field says what they should be about (a template gives an idea). my own: the field holds your lyrics, sung exactly as written. Only when vocals is sung, sparse vocals.

lyrics.title: lyrics idea or text
lyrics.description: The idea for the lyrics - a story, an image, a message - or, with 'my own', the lyrics themselves: sections as [Verse], [Chorus] ... (without them Plenio adds them). Only when vocals is sung, sparse vocals.
lyrics.default: Plain-spoken and personal, about a conversation that never happened.

melody.title: melody
melody.description: Whether an instrument carries a lead melody or the song is accompaniment only. Only when vocals is instrumental.

lead_instrument.title: lead instrument
lead_instrument.description: Optional lead instrument, e.g. 'saxophone'. Only when vocals is instrumental.

key.title: key
key.description: Optional key, e.g. 'G major'. Music models that use a score take the key from the score; the DAW template's empty score is built in it.

meter.title: meter
meter.description: Optional meter, e.g. '3/4' or '6/8'. Music models that use a score take the meter from the score; the DAW template's empty score is built in it.

arrangement.title: arrangement (experimental)
arrangement.description: off (default): the music model plans the music by itself. A creative mode (experimental) lets the writer plan chords, lines and energy per section; the line under the brief says what the chosen mode does.

genre_closeness.title: genre closeness
genre_closeness.description: Creative modes only (experimental): how close the song stays to its genre - 100 strictly typical, 70 typical with personal touches, 40 free within the genre, 0 any style.

lines_under_singing.title: lines under the singing (experimental)
lines_under_singing.description: Creative modes only (experimental): off - the instrument line plays where the voice rests, as in YuE2's own scores; on - it also sounds under the singing, calm and below the voice.

creativity.title: creativity
creativity.description: 0 steady ... 50 the reference (as before the slider) ... 100 experimental (the default) ... 200 adventurous: how much the writer and YuE2 dare. More surprises also means more misses - try a few seeds.

lyrics_fidelity.title: lyrics fidelity
lyrics_fidelity.description: standard: one take. high: a second take when the first sang under 96 % of the words as written; the better is kept. highest: a third when neither reached 96 %. Takes longer (up to 2x or 3x).

finish.hq_mastering.title: HQ mastering
finish.hq_mastering.description: Highest mastering quality: UniverSR (HQ 2) regenerates the highs - clearly fewer AI shimmer and artifacts, but the song takes about twice as long. Off (default; on in Enhance & Master): UniverSR is not needed.

finish.cover_art.title: Cover Art
finish.cover_art.description: Paints the cover from the artwork prompt the writer wrote (embedded in the files); off: no cover and no image model.

writer.model.title: model
writer.model.description: Gemma 4 12B (auto): the one on this machine, else downloaded for its card. A bare file name: a text model for ComfyUI's Generate Text. '… · …': a GGUF file ('models/LLM', 'HF cache' ...) or a running app's model.

folder.title: folder
folder.description: Sub-folder of the ComfyUI output folder.

naming.title: naming
naming.description: File name: {title}, {date}, {seed}, {genre}, {artist} ... (the variables of the tags); '/' makes sub-folders; [optional {parts}] vanish when empty.

collision.title: collision
collision.description: When the file exists: number (add ' (2)' - also to a title another song of the folder has), overwrite, or stop with an error.

wav.title: wav
wav.description: WAV 32-bit float (no clipping; few tags, no cover).

tags.title: tags
tags.description: Metadata written into the files: the title only, tags typed or connected (with {variables}), or the tags of the loaded file.

artist.title: artist
artist.description: The artist tag. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

album.title: album
album.description: The album tag. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

date.title: date
date.description: Year or date, e.g. 2026 or {date}. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

track.title: track
track.description: Track number, e.g. 3 or 3/12. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

genre.title: genre
genre.description: The genre tag, e.g. {genre} (the brief's). Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

comment.title: comment
comment.description: The comment tag; empty: none. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.
comment.default: [Genre: {genre} · ][Mood: {mood} · ][Language: {language} · ]Powered by Plenio Music Production System / ComfyUI

album_artist.title: album artist
album_artist.description: The album artist tag. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

composer.title: composer
composer.description: The composer tag. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

lyrics.title: lyrics
lyrics.description: The lyrics tag (FLAC, MP3; players show it), e.g. {lyrics}. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

sheet_music.title: sheet music
sheet_music.description: Also save the sheet music (both voices, chords, sections, the lyrics under the notes) as '<name>.pdf' on A4 or Letter pages; an open ComfyUI page draws it after the export. Needs a score (YuE2).

sheet_music_size.title: sheet music size
sheet_music_size.description: How large the sheet music draws: standard about 3 bars a line, smaller 3-4, compact about 4, large 1-2 (the biggest notes).

project_in_flac.title: project in FLAC
project_in_flac.description: Store the release record (workflow, Song Sheets, seeds, settings) inside the song's FLAC: File > Continue a Plenio song... opens the song from the FLAC alone. Off for files you share without their making-of.

lyrics_srt.title: lyrics subtitles (SRT)
lyrics_srt.description: Write the lyrics as subtitles: '(lines).srt' whole lines, '(notes).srt' note by note, '(sung).srt' what the take really sings. Timed by listening (Qwen3-ASR and its aligner, 5.9 GB, fetched on first use).

lyrics_timing.title: lyrics heard on
lyrics_timing.description: What the lyrics ASR hears for the subtitles and the player: the take's vocal stem - more exact times, the model of Stems and Sung Pitch, about half a minute per take - or the song (quicker).

song_page.title: song page (HTML)
song_page.description: Also write '<name>.html': the song on one page to open in any browser - the lyrics with their sections and the prompts to copy, every setting, how it was made, the sound, the score and links to the files.

documents.description: Documents the Song Sheets keep as manual: the run keeps them instead of writing or planning them anew. A song's documents with a new take seed make a new take of it (POST /songs/{id}/again makes one).

client.description: Who asks (kept with the job, shown in its listing): a name, a user, a reference.

strict.description: false: unknown fields are left out (named in warnings) instead of refused.

preset.description: Plenio 2.0: one of the player's six presets (resources/presets/make.json) - its fields and release values are used where the request names none; what the request names wins. 'takes' sets only its fields here (a job is one take).

stems.description: the take's stems (vocals, drums, bass, other and the rest) are saved beside the song and listed in its files (role 'stem'): the template's Stems switch is turned on. The song sounds the same; separating takes about half a minute more.

review.description: Stop at these Song Sheet stages and wait for POST /jobs/{id}/approve: 'text' (title, style, lyrics), 'score' (the score). [] stops nowhere - the DAW template's sheet then stops by itself only when the request leaves 'review' out.

mode.title: mode
mode.description: new cover every run (default): each run writes and renders another version, without stops. one cover, stop to review: the Song Sheets stop so you can check the transcription and the lyrics; later runs render new takes. Fixed in the API: a job asks for review stops with 'review'.

template.title: template
template.description: Optional target style. Style fields you leave empty are taken from the template.

description.title: description
description.description: How the cover should sound - instruments, feel, production. Sent to the writing model; a genre or a description is needed.
description.default: Modern dance-pop: four-on-the-floor kick, bright plucky synths, deep sidechained bass, claps, a tight pre-chorus build and an explosive chorus combining a sung hook with a post-chorus drop. Glossy radio production, huge and immediate.

vocals.title: vocals
vocals.description: original lyrics: the source's words, transcribed. new lyrics: new words on the source's melody. instrumental: an instrument plays the vocal melody, or accompaniment only.

melody.title: melody
melody.description: An instrument plays the vocal melody, or accompaniment only. Only when vocals is instrumental.

lead_instrument.title: lead instrument
lead_instrument.description: Optional lead instrument, e.g. 'piano'. Only when vocals is instrumental.

language.title: language
language.description: Language of the source's lyrics; 'auto' detects it from the singing. Only when vocals is original lyrics, new lyrics.

voice.title: voice
voice.description: Vocal character, e.g. 'soft female voice'. Only when vocals is original lyrics, new lyrics.

theme.title: theme
theme.description: What the new lyrics are about, e.g. 'leaving home'. Only when vocals is new lyrics.

phrasing_reference.title: phrasing reference
phrasing_reference.description: Show the writer the source's transcribed lyrics as a phrasing reference (runs the lyrics ASR). Only when vocals is new lyrics.

harmony.title: harmony
harmony.description: new accompaniment: the source's chords are removed and YuE2 re-harmonises (melody mode). keep original chords: the chords stay (full mode; the 2 · YuE2 · Cover template starts with it).

title.title: title
title.description: Optional fixed title, e.g. 'Original Title (Jazz Cover)'. Empty: the source recording's title with '-cover' when 'source' is connected; else the writer proposes one.

arrangement.title: arrangement (experimental)
arrangement.description: off (default): the transcribed score stays as it is. A creative mode (experimental) re-arranges the sections within the song flow closeness; the line under the brief says what the chosen mode does.

song_flow_closeness.title: song flow closeness
song_flow_closeness.description: Creative modes only (experimental): how close the cover stays to the original - 100 exactly, 80 chords and key stay, 50 recognisable, 20 a free version, 0 only a hint. The form always stays.

lyrics_closeness.title: lyrics closeness
lyrics_closeness.description: New lyrics only (experimental): how close they stay to the source's lyrics - 0 without its text (default), 30 its theme, 60 its story, 90-100 its meaning line by line.

lines_under_singing.title: lines under the singing (experimental)
lines_under_singing.description: Creative modes only (experimental): off - the instrument line plays where the voice rests, as in YuE2's own scores; on - it also sounds under the singing, calm and below the voice.

creativity.title: creativity
creativity.description: 0 steady ... 50 the reference (as before the slider) ... 100 experimental (the default) ... 200 adventurous: how much the writer and YuE2 dare. More surprises also means more misses - try a few seeds.

lyrics_fidelity.title: lyrics fidelity
lyrics_fidelity.description: standard: one take. high: a second take when the first sang under 96 % of the words as written; the better is kept. highest: a third when neither reached 96 %. Takes longer (up to 2x or 3x).

original_notes.title: original notes
original_notes.description: How many of the source's notes YuE2 gets: 100 all. Less leaves out the least important of the instrument line and chords (an instrumental's melody too; a sung one keeps all), nothing new; 0 about a quarter.

finish.hq_mastering.title: HQ mastering
finish.hq_mastering.description: Highest mastering quality: UniverSR (HQ 2) regenerates the highs - clearly fewer AI shimmer and artifacts, but the song takes about twice as long. Off (default; on in Enhance & Master): UniverSR is not needed.

finish.cover_art.title: Cover Art
finish.cover_art.description: Paints the cover from the artwork prompt the writer wrote (embedded in the files); off: no cover and no image model.

writer.model.title: model
writer.model.description: Gemma 4 12B (auto): the one on this machine, else downloaded for its card. A bare file name: a text model for ComfyUI's Generate Text. '… · …': a GGUF file ('models/LLM', 'HF cache' ...) or a running app's model.

source.audio.title: audio
source.audio.description: A recording in ComfyUI's input folder: upload it with POST /uploads?name=<file> and give the answer's name here.

excerpt.start_index.title: start index
excerpt.start_index.description: Start time in seconds, can be negative to count from the end (supports sub-seconds).

excerpt.enabled.title: Excerpt
excerpt.enabled.description: Whether the optional node 'Excerpt (optional)' runs (bypassed when off).

folder.title: folder
folder.description: Sub-folder of the ComfyUI output folder.

naming.title: naming
naming.description: File name: {title}, {date}, {seed}, {genre}, {artist} ... (the variables of the tags); '/' makes sub-folders; [optional {parts}] vanish when empty.

collision.title: collision
collision.description: When the file exists: number (add ' (2)' - also to a title another song of the folder has), overwrite, or stop with an error.

wav.title: wav
wav.description: WAV 32-bit float (no clipping; few tags, no cover).

tags.title: tags
tags.description: Metadata written into the files: the title only, tags typed or connected (with {variables}), or the tags of the loaded file.

artist.title: artist
artist.description: The artist tag. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

album.title: album
album.description: The album tag. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

date.title: date
date.description: Year or date, e.g. 2026 or {date}. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

track.title: track
track.description: Track number, e.g. 3 or 3/12. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

genre.title: genre
genre.description: The genre tag, e.g. {genre} (the brief's). Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

comment.title: comment
comment.description: The comment tag; empty: none. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.
comment.default: [Genre: {genre} · ][Mood: {mood} · ][Language: {language} · ]Powered by Plenio Music Production System / ComfyUI

album_artist.title: album artist
album_artist.description: The album artist tag. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

composer.title: composer
composer.description: The composer tag. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

lyrics.title: lyrics
lyrics.description: The lyrics tag (FLAC, MP3; players show it), e.g. {lyrics}. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

sheet_music.title: sheet music
sheet_music.description: Also save the sheet music (both voices, chords, sections, the lyrics under the notes) as '<name>.pdf' on A4 or Letter pages; an open ComfyUI page draws it after the export. Needs a score (YuE2).

sheet_music_size.title: sheet music size
sheet_music_size.description: How large the sheet music draws: standard about 3 bars a line, smaller 3-4, compact about 4, large 1-2 (the biggest notes).

project_in_flac.title: project in FLAC
project_in_flac.description: Store the release record (workflow, Song Sheets, seeds, settings) inside the song's FLAC: File > Continue a Plenio song... opens the song from the FLAC alone. Off for files you share without their making-of.

lyrics_srt.title: lyrics subtitles (SRT)
lyrics_srt.description: Write the lyrics as subtitles: '(lines).srt' whole lines, '(notes).srt' note by note, '(sung).srt' what the take really sings. Timed by listening (Qwen3-ASR and its aligner, 5.9 GB, fetched on first use).

lyrics_timing.title: lyrics heard on
lyrics_timing.description: What the lyrics ASR hears for the subtitles and the player: the take's vocal stem - more exact times, the model of Stems and Sung Pitch, about half a minute per take - or the song (quicker).

song_page.title: song page (HTML)
song_page.description: Also write '<name>.html': the song on one page to open in any browser - the lyrics with their sections and the prompts to copy, every setting, how it was made, the sound, the score and links to the files.

documents.description: Documents the Song Sheets keep as manual: the run keeps them instead of writing or planning them anew. A song's documents with a new take seed make a new take of it (POST /songs/{id}/again makes one).

client.description: Who asks (kept with the job, shown in its listing): a name, a user, a reference.

strict.description: false: unknown fields are left out (named in warnings) instead of refused.

preset.description: Plenio 2.0: one of the player's six presets (resources/presets/make.json) - its fields and release values are used where the request names none; what the request names wins. 'takes' sets only its fields here (a job is one take).

stems.description: the take's stems (vocals, drums, bass, other and the rest) are saved beside the song and listed in its files (role 'stem'): the template's Stems switch is turned on. The song sounds the same; separating takes about half a minute more.

review.description: Stop at these Song Sheet stages and wait for POST /jobs/{id}/approve: 'text' (title, style, lyrics), 'score' (the score). [] stops nowhere - the DAW template's sheet then stops by itself only when the request leaves 'review' out.

mode.title: mode
mode.description: new song every run: each run writes and renders another song from this brief (the batch count next to Run makes a series). one song, stop to review: the Song Sheets stop for checking; later runs render new takes. Fixed in the API: a job asks for review stops with 'review'.

template.title: template
template.description: Optional starting point. Text fields you leave empty are taken from the template.

description.title: description
description.description: How the song should sound - its character, instruments and arrangement (the lyrics have a field of their own). Sent to the writing model.
description.default: Honest acoustic singer-songwriter song: fingerpicked or gently strummed acoustic guitar, subtle piano, upright bass and brushed drums entering late, plus a close, unpolished vocal with audible breath. Conversational verses, one quietly devastating refrain, minimal production and lots of space.

length.title: length
length.description: Target length. Guides the writing and, without a score, the render ceiling.

vocals.title: vocals
vocals.description: sung: a song with lyrics. sparse vocals: mostly instrumental, the voice sings only a few short phrases (a hook, a call, wordless sounds like 'ooh'). instrumental: no singing; hides all vocal settings.

language.title: language
language.description: Language of the lyrics, e.g. 'English'. Only when vocals is sung, sparse vocals.

voice.title: voice
voice.description: Vocal character, e.g. 'warm female voice'. Only when vocals is sung, sparse vocals.

theme.title: theme
theme.description: What the lyrics are about, in a few words. Only when vocals is sung, sparse vocals.

enum: my own, sung as written below
lyrics_from.title: lyrics
lyrics_from.description: written from the idea below: the writer writes the lyrics; the field says what they should be about (a template gives an idea). my own: the field holds your lyrics, sung exactly as written. Only when vocals is sung, sparse vocals.

lyrics.title: lyrics idea or text
lyrics.description: The idea for the lyrics - a story, an image, a message - or, with 'my own', the lyrics themselves: sections as [Verse], [Chorus] ... (without them Plenio adds them). Only when vocals is sung, sparse vocals.
lyrics.default: Plain-spoken and personal, about a conversation that never happened.

melody.title: melody
melody.description: Whether an instrument carries a lead melody or the song is accompaniment only. Only when vocals is instrumental.

lead_instrument.title: lead instrument
lead_instrument.description: Optional lead instrument, e.g. 'saxophone'. Only when vocals is instrumental.

key.title: key
key.description: Optional key, e.g. 'G major'. Music models that use a score take the key from the score; the DAW template's empty score is built in it.

meter.title: meter
meter.description: Optional meter, e.g. '3/4' or '6/8'. Music models that use a score take the meter from the score; the DAW template's empty score is built in it.

arrangement.title: arrangement (experimental)
arrangement.description: off (default): the music model plans the music by itself. A creative mode (experimental) lets the writer plan chords, lines and energy per section; the line under the brief says what the chosen mode does.

genre_closeness.title: genre closeness
genre_closeness.description: Creative modes only (experimental): how close the song stays to its genre - 100 strictly typical, 70 typical with personal touches, 40 free within the genre, 0 any style.

lines_under_singing.title: lines under the singing (experimental)
lines_under_singing.description: Creative modes only (experimental): off - the instrument line plays where the voice rests, as in YuE2's own scores; on - it also sounds under the singing, calm and below the voice.

creativity.title: creativity
creativity.description: 0 steady ... 50 the reference (as before the slider) ... 100 experimental (the default) ... 200 adventurous: how much the writer and YuE2 dare. More surprises also means more misses - try a few seeds.

lyrics_fidelity.description: standard: one take. high: a second take when the first sang under 96 % of the words as written; the better is kept. highest: a third when neither reached 96 %. Takes longer (up to 2x or 3x).

source.audio.title: audio
source.audio.description: A recording in ComfyUI's input folder: upload it with POST /uploads?name=<file> and give the answer's name here.

h_q_stereo_cleanup.preset.title: preset
h_q_stereo_cleanup.preset.description: auto: the profile that fits the song's genre (from the connected brief; standard without one). standard, gentle, strong and wide are the same four profiles in HQ 1, 2 and 3; custom shows the fields.

h_q_stereo_cleanup.preset.side_highcut_h.title: side highcut hz
h_q_stereo_cleanup.preset.side_highcut_h.description: Above this the side signal is cut (Hz, zero-phase). Only when h_q_stereo_cleanup.preset is custom - the fields below.

h_q_stereo_cleanup.preset.side_cleanup.title: side cleanup
h_q_stereo_cleanup.preset.side_cleanup.description: 0 off ... 1 strongest: the high-cut's share and the cleanup of the side's diffuse highs. Only when h_q_stereo_cleanup.preset is custom - the fields below.

h_q_stereo_cleanup.preset.warmth.title: warmth
h_q_stereo_cleanup.preset.warmth.description: 0 off ... 0.8: saturation above 400 Hz (2nd and 3rd harmonics). Only when h_q_stereo_cleanup.preset is custom - the fields below.

audio_model_loader.kind.title: kind
audio_model_loader.kind.description: super-resolution: for HQ 2 · Regenerate Highs and Refine (48 kHz); separation: for Separate Stems.

audio_model_loader.kind.model.title: model
audio_model_loader.kind.model.description: A model file in models/audio_sr. Only when audio_model_loader.kind is super-resolution, separation.

h_q_regenerate_highs.preset.title: preset
h_q_regenerate_highs.preset.description: auto: the profile that fits the song's genre (from the connected brief; standard without one). standard, gentle, strong and wide are the same four profiles in HQ 1, 2 and 3; custom shows the fields.

h_q_regenerate_highs.preset.from_hz.title: from hz
h_q_regenerate_highs.preset.from_hz.description: New highs from (Hz): the crossover. The model sees the song up to its nearest input edge below it (UniverSR: 4, 6, 8 or 12 kHz). Only when h_q_regenerate_highs.preset is custom - the fields below.

h_q_regenerate_highs.preset.new_share.title: new share
h_q_regenerate_highs.preset.new_share.description: Share of the new highs above the crossover; the rest stays the original's. Only when h_q_regenerate_highs.preset is custom - the fields below.

h_q_regenerate_highs.preset.level_match.title: level match
h_q_regenerate_highs.preset.level_match.description: The new highs follow the original's level (40 ms envelope) times this. Only when h_q_regenerate_highs.preset is custom - the fields below.

h_q_regenerate_highs.seed.title: seed
h_q_regenerate_highs.seed.description: Seed of the model: the same seed gives the same highs.

h_q_regenerate_highs.model_steps.title: model steps
h_q_regenerate_highs.model_steps.description: UniverSR's flow steps: 4 (default) about 1.5 s per second of music on an RTX 5060 Ti, 3 about 1.1 s, 2 about 0.75 s - fewer steps, other and quieter highs.

h_q_de_reverb.preset.title: preset
h_q_de_reverb.preset.description: auto: the profile that fits the song's genre (from the connected brief; standard without one). standard, gentle, strong and wide are the same four profiles in HQ 1, 2 and 3; custom shows the fields.

h_q_de_reverb.preset.dereverb.title: dereverb
h_q_de_reverb.preset.dereverb.description: 0 off ... 1: how much of the late, diffuse room above 600 Hz is taken out. Only when h_q_de_reverb.preset is custom - the fields below.

h_q_de_reverb.preset.phase_lock.title: phase lock
h_q_de_reverb.preset.phase_lock.description: 0 off ... 1: how far the phase above 2 kHz follows its strong neighbours. Only when h_q_de_reverb.preset is custom - the fields below.

h_q_de_reverb.enabled.title: HQ 3 · De-Reverb
h_q_de_reverb.enabled.description: Whether the optional node 'HQ 3 · De-Reverb (optional)' runs (bypassed when off).

e_q.mode.title: mode
e_q.mode.description: flat: no change; manual: your bands; match: a proposal fitted to the audio.

e_q.mode.bands.title: bands
e_q.mode.bands.description: EQ bands (plenio.eq/1); edit them on the curve. Only when e_q.mode is manual.

e_q.mode.preset.title: preset
e_q.mode.preset.description: Tone match recipes (reference recipes need the reference input). Only when e_q.mode is match preset.

e_q.mode.target.title: target
e_q.mode.target.description: warm / bright: a gentle tilt around 1 kHz; reference: the tone of the reference input. Only when e_q.mode is custom match.

e_q.mode.strength.title: strength
e_q.mode.strength.description: How far to move towards the target. Only when e_q.mode is custom match.

e_q.mode.max_gain_db.title: max gain db
e_q.mode.max_gain_db.description: Largest boost or cut of the curve. Only when e_q.mode is custom match.

e_q.mode.max_bands.title: max bands
e_q.mode.max_bands.description: Most peak bands the match may use. Only when e_q.mode is custom match.

e_q.mode.min_hz.title: min hz
e_q.mode.min_hz.description: Lowest frequency the match measures and may place a band at (Hz). Only when e_q.mode is custom match.

e_q.mode.max_hz.title: max hz
e_q.mode.max_hz.description: Highest frequency the match measures and may place a band at (Hz; at most 45 % of the sample rate). Only when e_q.mode is custom match.

loudness.target.lufs.title: lufs
loudness.target.lufs.description: Integrated loudness (LUFS). Only when loudness.target is custom.

loudness.target.ceiling_dbtp.title: ceiling dbtp
loudness.target.ceiling_dbtp.description: True-peak ceiling (dBTP). Only when loudness.target is custom.

loudness.compression.title: compression
loudness.compression.description: off: limiter only; a style: gentle genre presets; custom: your settings.

loudness.compression.threshold_db.title: threshold db
loudness.compression.threshold_db.description: Level above which the compressor works (dB). Only when loudness.compression is custom.

loudness.compression.ratio.title: ratio
loudness.compression.ratio.description: Compression ratio above the threshold. Only when loudness.compression is custom.

loudness.compression.knee_db.title: knee db
loudness.compression.knee_db.description: Width of the soft knee around the threshold (dB); 0 is a hard knee. Only when loudness.compression is custom.

loudness.compression.attack_ms.title: attack ms
loudness.compression.attack_ms.description: How fast the compressor reacts (ms). Only when loudness.compression is custom.

loudness.compression.release_ms.title: release ms
loudness.compression.release_ms.description: How fast it lets go (ms). Only when loudness.compression is custom.

loudness.compression.sidechain_hz.title: sidechain hz
loudness.compression.sidechain_hz.description: High-pass on what the compressor listens to (Hz), so the bass does not pump it; 0 is off. Only when loudness.compression is custom.

loudness.compression.detector.title: detector
loudness.compression.detector.description: RMS follows the average level (smooth); Peak reacts to single peaks. Only when loudness.compression is custom.

preset.description: Plenio 2.0: one of the player's six presets (resources/presets/make.json) - its fields and release values are used where the request names none; what the request names wins. 'takes' sets only its fields here (a job is one take).

stems.description: the take's stems (vocals, drums, bass, other and the rest) are saved beside the song and listed in its files (role 'stem'): the template's Stems switch is turned on. The song sounds the same; separating takes about half a minute more.

review.description: Stop at these Song Sheet stages and wait for POST /jobs/{id}/approve: 'text' (title, style, lyrics), 'score' (the score). [] stops nowhere - the DAW template's sheet then stops by itself only when the request leaves 'review' out.

mode.title: mode
mode.description: new song every run: each run writes and renders another song from this brief (the batch count next to Run makes a series). one song, stop to review: the Song Sheets stop for checking; later runs render new takes. Fixed in the API: a job asks for review stops with 'review'.

template.title: template
template.description: Optional starting point. Text fields you leave empty are taken from the template.

description.title: description
description.description: How the song should sound - its character, instruments and arrangement (the lyrics have a field of their own). Sent to the writing model.
description.default: Honest acoustic singer-songwriter song: fingerpicked or gently strummed acoustic guitar, subtle piano, upright bass and brushed drums entering late, plus a close, unpolished vocal with audible breath. Conversational verses, one quietly devastating refrain, minimal production and lots of space.

length.title: length
length.description: Target length. Guides the writing and, without a score, the render ceiling.

vocals.title: vocals
vocals.description: sung: a song with lyrics. sparse vocals: mostly instrumental, the voice sings only a few short phrases (a hook, a call, wordless sounds like 'ooh'). instrumental: no singing; hides all vocal settings.

language.title: language
language.description: Language of the lyrics, e.g. 'English'. Only when vocals is sung, sparse vocals.

voice.title: voice
voice.description: Vocal character, e.g. 'warm female voice'. Only when vocals is sung, sparse vocals.

theme.title: theme
theme.description: What the lyrics are about, in a few words. Only when vocals is sung, sparse vocals.

enum: my own, sung as written below
lyrics_from.title: lyrics
lyrics_from.description: written from the idea below: the writer writes the lyrics; the field says what they should be about (a template gives an idea). my own: the field holds your lyrics, sung exactly as written. Only when vocals is sung, sparse vocals.

lyrics.title: lyrics idea or text
lyrics.description: The idea for the lyrics - a story, an image, a message - or, with 'my own', the lyrics themselves: sections as [Verse], [Chorus] ... (without them Plenio adds them). Only when vocals is sung, sparse vocals.
lyrics.default: Plain-spoken and personal, about a conversation that never happened.

melody.title: melody
melody.description: Whether an instrument carries a lead melody or the song is accompaniment only. Only when vocals is instrumental.

lead_instrument.title: lead instrument
lead_instrument.description: Optional lead instrument, e.g. 'saxophone'. Only when vocals is instrumental.

key.title: key
key.description: Optional key, e.g. 'G major'. Music models that use a score take the key from the score; the DAW template's empty score is built in it.

meter.title: meter
meter.description: Optional meter, e.g. '3/4' or '6/8'. Music models that use a score take the meter from the score; the DAW template's empty score is built in it.

arrangement.title: arrangement (experimental)
arrangement.description: off (default): the music model plans the music by itself. A creative mode (experimental) lets the writer plan chords, lines and energy per section; the line under the brief says what the chosen mode does.

genre_closeness.title: genre closeness
genre_closeness.description: Creative modes only (experimental): how close the song stays to its genre - 100 strictly typical, 70 typical with personal touches, 40 free within the genre, 0 any style.

lines_under_singing.title: lines under the singing (experimental)
lines_under_singing.description: Creative modes only (experimental): off - the instrument line plays where the voice rests, as in YuE2's own scores; on - it also sounds under the singing, calm and below the voice.

creativity.title: creativity
creativity.description: 0 steady ... 50 the reference (as before the slider) ... 100 experimental (the default) ... 200 adventurous: how much the writer and YuE2 dare. More surprises also means more misses - try a few seeds.

lyrics_fidelity.title: lyrics fidelity
lyrics_fidelity.description: standard: one take. high: a second take when the first sang under 96 % of the words as written; the better is kept. highest: a third when neither reached 96 %. Takes longer (up to 2x or 3x).

finish.hq_mastering.title: HQ mastering
finish.hq_mastering.description: Highest mastering quality: UniverSR (HQ 2) regenerates the highs - clearly fewer AI shimmer and artifacts, but the song takes about twice as long. Off (default; on in Enhance & Master): UniverSR is not needed.

finish.cover_art.title: Cover Art
finish.cover_art.description: Paints the cover from the artwork prompt the writer wrote (embedded in the files); off: no cover and no image model.

writer.model.title: model
writer.model.description: Gemma 4 12B (auto): the one on this machine, else downloaded for its card. A bare file name: a text model for ComfyUI's Generate Text. '… · …': a GGUF file ('models/LLM', 'HF cache' ...) or a running app's model.

folder.title: folder
folder.description: Sub-folder of the ComfyUI output folder.

naming.title: naming
naming.description: File name: {title}, {date}, {seed}, {genre}, {artist} ... (the variables of the tags); '/' makes sub-folders; [optional {parts}] vanish when empty.

collision.title: collision
collision.description: When the file exists: number (add ' (2)' - also to a title another song of the folder has), overwrite, or stop with an error.

wav.title: wav
wav.description: WAV 32-bit float (no clipping; few tags, no cover).

tags.title: tags
tags.description: Metadata written into the files: the title only, tags typed or connected (with {variables}), or the tags of the loaded file.

artist.title: artist
artist.description: The artist tag. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

album.title: album
album.description: The album tag. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

date.title: date
date.description: Year or date, e.g. 2026 or {date}. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

track.title: track
track.description: Track number, e.g. 3 or 3/12. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

genre.title: genre
genre.description: The genre tag, e.g. {genre} (the brief's). Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

comment.title: comment
comment.description: The comment tag; empty: none. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.
comment.default: [Genre: {genre} · ][Mood: {mood} · ][Language: {language} · ]Powered by Plenio Music Production System / ComfyUI

album_artist.title: album artist
album_artist.description: The album artist tag. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

composer.title: composer
composer.description: The composer tag. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

lyrics.title: lyrics
lyrics.description: The lyrics tag (FLAC, MP3; players show it), e.g. {lyrics}. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

sheet_music.title: sheet music
sheet_music.description: Also save the sheet music (both voices, chords, sections, the lyrics under the notes) as '<name>.pdf' on A4 or Letter pages; an open ComfyUI page draws it after the export. Needs a score (YuE2).

sheet_music_size.title: sheet music size
sheet_music_size.description: How large the sheet music draws: standard about 3 bars a line, smaller 3-4, compact about 4, large 1-2 (the biggest notes).

project_in_flac.title: project in FLAC
project_in_flac.description: Store the release record (workflow, Song Sheets, seeds, settings) inside the song's FLAC: File > Continue a Plenio song... opens the song from the FLAC alone. Off for files you share without their making-of.

lyrics_srt.title: lyrics subtitles (SRT)
lyrics_srt.description: Write the lyrics as subtitles: '(lines).srt' whole lines, '(notes).srt' note by note, '(sung).srt' what the take really sings. Timed by listening (Qwen3-ASR and its aligner, 5.9 GB, fetched on first use).

lyrics_timing.title: lyrics heard on
lyrics_timing.description: What the lyrics ASR hears for the subtitles and the player: the take's vocal stem - more exact times, the model of Stems and Sung Pitch, about half a minute per take - or the song (quicker).

song_page.title: song page (HTML)
song_page.description: Also write '<name>.html': the song on one page to open in any browser - the lyrics with their sections and the prompts to copy, every setting, how it was made, the sound, the score and links to the files.

documents.description: Documents the Song Sheets keep as manual: the run keeps them instead of writing or planning them anew. A song's documents with a new take seed make a new take of it (POST /songs/{id}/again makes one).

client.description: Who asks (kept with the job, shown in its listing): a name, a user, a reference.

strict.description: false: unknown fields are left out (named in warnings) instead of refused.

preset.description: Plenio 2.0: one of the player's six presets (resources/presets/make.json) - its fields and release values are used where the request names none; what the request names wins. 'takes' sets only its fields here (a job is one take).

stems.description: the take's stems (vocals, drums, bass, other and the rest) are saved beside the song and listed in its files (role 'stem'): the template's Stems switch is turned on. The song sounds the same; separating takes about half a minute more.

review.description: Stop at these Song Sheet stages and wait for POST /jobs/{id}/approve: 'text' (title, style, lyrics), 'score' (the score). [] stops nowhere - the DAW template's sheet then stops by itself only when the request leaves 'review' out.

token.description: Another computer only (with [api] remote = "token", the default): a token made in Plenio Setup > API access, 'Authorization: Bearer plenio_...'. This computer needs none.
